COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

3. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

4. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

5. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

6. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.

7. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.

8. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

9. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

10. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.

11. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.

12. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Program Development Overview and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Identifiers and Operators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures 3.5 Data Structures 3.6 Functions Page 15 of 72 1 STRAND 1.0: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
